subject.title: Control UI: Model provider display shows original config value instead of normalized value (e.g., 'bailian' vs 'zai')

question: Should Control UI show canonical provider ids on derived Sessions/Usage display, filters, CSV, and aggregate keys, or preserve configured aliases with added context?
rationale: The source defect is clear, but the choice affects visible provider identity, exported CSV values, and aggregate grouping semantics rather than only a local render string.

options.title: Canonicalize derived surfaces
options.body: Normalize derived display/filter/suggestion/CSV/aggregate values using the provider-id contract while preserving raw stored config and session fields.

options.title: Show alias with canonical context
options.body: Display labels like `zai (alias: z-ai)` where aliases matter, accepting broader UI copy and test surface.

options.title: Preserve raw aliases
options.body: Keep current display/export/grouping behavior and document that Control UI reflects stored provider keys.

recommendation.title: Canonicalize derived surfaces
recommendation.body: Normalize derived display/filter/suggestion/CSV/aggregate values using the provider-id contract while preserving raw stored config and session fields.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available owner signal from provider alias work and the Usage UI split/refactor history.
